name: Minakami (Japan, –2005)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Minakami town emblem in white: a winged ring of concentric arcs enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Minakami in Gunma Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-01.

features.role: Minakami town emblem — a winged ring of concentric arcs enclosing a stylised character
